name: Fangore's Paw
summary: In the Redridge Mountains, Fangore leads the Shadowhide gnolls against Lakeshire. His severed paw proves his death to Magistrate Solomon and may ease the danger closing around the town.

sections.title: Trophy of a Fallen Chieftain
sections.body: Lieutenant Fangore leads the Shadowhide gnolls across the Redridge Mountains. He serves the renegade mage Morganth and directs attacks on trade roads, outlying farms, and the defenses around Lake Everstill. The gnolls leave no uniforms, seals, or banners behind to identify their dead. So Magistrate Solomon demands Fangore's paw as proof that the lieutenant has been executed, giving Lakeshire some relief amid the dangers around town.

faq.q: Who does this paw belong to?
faq.answer: The paw belongs to Lieutenant Fangore, a notorious leader among the Shadowhide gnolls in the Redridge Mountains. He directs raids and serves the dark wizard Morganth.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Solomon want the paw?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon posted a wanted mandate condemning Fangore as a vile enemy of Stormwind. He requires the severed paw as physical proof that the Shadowhide lieutenant has been slain.

faq.q: Who is Lieutenant Fangore working for?
faq.answer: Fangore serves Morganth, a rogue practitioner of dark magic. Morganth threatens Lakeshire from his tower in the eastern mountains and directs gnoll activity against the kingdom.
Lieutenant Fangore operates in the Redridge Mountains among the hostile Shadowhide gnoll encampments.

angles.text: As an Alliance hero, bringing Fangore down and returning his paw brings relief to Lakeshire. The beleaguered town receives scarce military support from Stormwind.
